claims: The final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Sunday, April 12.
Final round coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs on CBS from 2-7 p.m. ET.
Early action for the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Paramount+, Fubo, and ESPN+.
Early action for the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament provides featured groups and Amen Corner.
Featured Groups/Holes coverage for the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs at 9:15 a.m. CT / 10:15 a.m. ET on ESPN+ and Masters.com.
Early coverage for the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs from 12 p.m. - 2 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
The main broadcast for the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs from 2 p.m. - 7 p.m. ET on CBS, Paramount+, and Fubo.
Masters.com offers free streams of the broadcast and featured holes.
The Masters App offers free streams of the broadcast and featured holes.
The Masters App provides Augusta National's dedicated feeds, including Amen Corner and Featured Groups.
